Historical builder and current executed C++ build receipts remain separate.
Loading environment.env supplies the original capture identity only; the caller
must supply PANDAD_PROTOCOL_SOURCE_MANIFEST, explicit fresh/borrowed build kind,
and actual current source/native executables. Never label the historical builder
as a fresh build. The full native reference, controls and fixture adversarial
checks must pass in the grouped hosted gate. Source deletion is accepted only
after that gate requires actual checkout/private-root absence and preserves all
protocol/alert/CLI/failure cases. The shared Python corpus can be removed only
with both protocol and CAN-I/O callers migrated.
